subject.title: fix(zai): add user-agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Which Z.AI User-Agent fix path should be treated as canonical before merge: this one-line branch after added proof/tests, or a better-tested sibling PR?
rationale: The code shape is plausible and in the right owner boundary, but contributor proof is mock-only and several open branches compete for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
options.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage plus live proof or an explicit maintainer proof waiver, then close the duplicate candidates after it lands.

options.title: Continue this PR after proof
options.body: Ask this contributor to add a focused header regression test and redacted after-fix Z.AI endpoint-detection proof before keeping this branch as the landing candidate.

options.title: Waive live proof for the minimal patch
options.body: Maintainers can accept the issue's live before-fix evidence plus source inspection, but should still land only one duplicate fix.

recommendation.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
recommendation.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage plus live proof or an explicit maintainer proof waiver, then close the duplicate candidates after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The original endpoint auto-detection feature history and current carried-forward extension file both point to steipete as the strongest routing owner for the canonical landing decision.
